title: Privacy Policy
description: How MétodoAI handles personal data: what we collect, why we use it, who we share it with, how long we keep it and how to request deletion, including WhatsApp data.

blocks.p: MétodoAI (metodotia.com) is a business management platform. It brings together a CRM, WhatsApp support and campaigns, prospecting, proposals, finance, HR and other modules. The platform is operated by:

ul: **{legalName}** (trade name {tradeName})
CNPJ (Brazilian company registration) {cnpj}
{address}, Brazil
Privacy e-mail: {email}

blocks.p: In this Policy, "MétodoAI", "we" and "us" mean that company; "Customer" is the company that subscribes to the platform; and "User" is the person who accesses the platform on behalf of a Customer.

This Policy explains what personal data we process, what it is used for, who it is shared with, how long it is kept and how you can exercise your rights. It follows Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018, "LGPD") and the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Law No. 12,965/2014).

ul: **We are the controller** of Users' account registration and usage data, of Customers' subscription and billing data, and of data about visitors to our website.

**We are a processor** of the data Customers record or receive on the platform about other people: contacts, clients, suppliers, employees and WhatsApp conversations. We process that data only to provide the service and following the Customer's instructions.
**The Customer is the controller of that data.** It is up to the Customer to have a legal basis to use it, including the contacts' prior authorization (opt-in) to receive WhatsApp messages.

blocks.p: If you talked to a company that uses MétodoAI, that company decides how your data is used. Section 12 explains how to request deletion.

ul: Name, e-mail, phone number and CPF or CNPJ (Brazilian taxpayer IDs).
Password, stored only in irreversible encrypted form (hash). We never store the password in plain text.
When you sign in with Google, Microsoft or LinkedIn: name, e-mail and, when available, profile picture provided by those services.
Company, access profile, invitations and preferences, such as language.
Contact and company records: name, phone number, e-mail, CNPJ and address.
Sales opportunities, proposals, tasks and attachments.
Financial entries, employee data (HR), inventory and any other information the Customer records.

blocks.p: When a Customer connects a phone number to the platform, we process:

ul: **From contacts who talk to the Customer:** phone number, profile name and WhatsApp user identifier; message content (text, images, audio, video, documents, stickers and reactions); date and time, and delivery and read status.
**From the Customer:** WhatsApp Business account and phone number identifiers, access token (stored encrypted) and message templates.

blocks.p: Search results from public sources, such as Google Places and the searched company's own website: business name, phone number, address and website.
IP address, access date and time, browser and device data, and a record of actions taken on the platform (audit log).
MétodoAI integrates with Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) so Customers can support and message their contacts. Regarding the data received through this integration:

ul: **We use this data only to** show conversations to the Customer, send the messages the Customer requests, display delivery and read status and, if the Customer turns the feature on, generate replies with the AI agent (section 6).
**We do not sell or rent this data.** Nor do we use it for advertising, profiling or any purpose of our own.
**We do not use conversation content to train artificial intelligence models.**
We do not share this data with third parties, except the providers needed to run the service (section 7) or when required by law.
Each number's access token is stored encrypted. Within the Customer's company, only the user responsible for the number can access its conversations.
The Customer is responsible for obtaining contacts' opt-in before messaging them, for complying with the WhatsApp Business Policy and the Commerce Policy, and for the content it sends.

To stop receiving messages, a contact can ask the company, use the unsubscribe option when offered (unsubscribed contacts are left out of campaigns) or, in WhatsApp itself, block the company or stop receiving marketing messages.
Messages are also processed by Meta, under WhatsApp's Terms and Privacy Policy (https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy).

Some numbers are connected by scanning a QR code. In that case, messages go through a messaging server operated by MétodoAI at a contracted hosting provider, and the rules in this section apply in the same way.

sections.title: 5. Why we use data and on what legal basis

head: Purpose
Legal basis (LGPD)
rows: Create and maintain the account, authenticate access and provide the contracted services
Send service e-mails: verification, invitations, password reset and notices
Bill the subscription and meet tax obligations
Performance of a contract and legal obligation (art. 7, II and V)
Ensure security, prevent fraud and abuse and keep the audit log
Legitimate interest and regular exercise of rights (art. 7, VI and IX)
Provide support and improve the platform
Process data on behalf of Customers
The legal basis defined by the Customer, who is the controller

ul: **Copilot (assistant).** When a User uses the copilot, the question and the platform data needed to answer it are sent to Anthropic (Claude). Image generation requests are sent to OpenAI.
**WhatsApp support agent.** If the Customer turns the agent on, incoming messages are processed by Anthropic to generate automatic replies. Audio messages may be transcribed by OpenAI.
Under these providers' commercial terms, data sent through their APIs is not used to train their models.
The Customer decides whether to turn these features on and is responsible for how the generated replies are used.

blocks.p: We do not sell personal data. We share data only with the providers that help us run the platform, and only as far as needed:

head: Provider
Purpose
rows: Sign in with Google and prospecting searches (Google Places)

blocks.p: We may also share data with public authorities when legally required, and in a corporate transaction such as a merger or acquisition, provided the protection set out in this Policy is maintained.

Some providers store or process data outside Brazil, mainly in the United States. In those cases, the transfer follows article 33 of the LGPD and relies on contractual clauses and the data protection safeguards offered by those providers.

ul: **Account and CRM data:** while the account is active. After the account is closed or a deletion request is made, it is erased within 30 days.
**Access logs:** 6 months, as required by the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework.
**Tax and billing data:** for the period required by law, usually 5 years.
**Prospecting results:** automatically deleted after 30 days. Only what the Customer imports into the CRM remains.

**WhatsApp conversations:** for as long as the Customer keeps them. Users can delete conversations. Removing a number connected through the official API deletes that number's conversations, messages and files.
**Backups:** erased in the automatic rotation cycle.

blocks.p: We may keep data beyond these periods when needed to comply with a legal obligation or to exercise rights in legal proceedings (LGPD, art. 16).

ul: Encrypted connection (HTTPS).
Passwords protected by hashing (bcrypt).
Integration tokens and credentials encrypted (AES-256-GCM).
Separation of each Customer company's data.
Permissions by user profile and an audit log of actions.

blocks.p: No system is completely immune to failure. If an incident may cause relevant risk or harm, we will notify Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) and the affected data subjects, as required by article 48 of the LGPD.
Under the LGPD (art. 18), you can request:

ul: confirmation that we process your data;
access to the data;
correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data;
anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data or data processed unlawfully;
portability;
deletion of data processed based on your consent;
information about who we share your data with;
withdrawal of consent;
objection to processing;
review of decisions made solely by automated means.

blocks.p: **How to request:** send an e-mail to {email}. We may ask you to confirm your identity. We reply within **15 days**.
If the request concerns data we process as a processor, we forward it to the responsible Customer and help handle it.
You can also file a complaint with Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (https://www.gov.br/anpd).

sections.title: 12. How to request deletion of your data

blocks.h3: If you are a MétodoAI User

ol: Inside the platform, you can delete contacts, conversations and other records. Removing a WhatsApp number connected through the official API deletes that number's conversations and files.
To delete the account and all its data, send an e-mail to {email} with the subject **"Data deletion"**, from the registered e-mail address, stating the company name.
We confirm the request within 15 days and complete the deletion within 30 days. Only the data the law requires us to keep is excluded (section 9).

blocks.h3: If you talked to a company on WhatsApp or were registered by a Customer

ol: Ask the company directly, or send an e-mail to {email} with the subject **"Data deletion – WhatsApp"**, stating your phone number with country and area code and the company name.
We locate the data, contact the responsible company and reply within 15 days.

blocks.p: We only use essential cookies:

ul: **Session:** keeps you signed in. Expires within 7 days or when you sign out.
**Language:** remembers the chosen language.

blocks.p: We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking or analytics tools. If you block cookies, sign-in may not work.
The platform is intended for businesses and for people aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect data from children or adolescents as Users.
We may update this Policy. The "Last updated" date at the top shows the version in force. We announce relevant changes by e-mail or by a notice on the platform.
